admission.justification: A repair can close while the tests matching its own touched names never run, and an unbounded hunt for unrelated defects would widen a sealed review past the finding it answers.

applicability: A repair round that answers a sealed finding, on the Worker's and the Reviewer's side of the lane.
conditions: The repair's own touched names are searched, including names the repair introduces.
In fix-verification the repaired finding stays open until the tests matching those names have run.
exclusions: An unrun test that the search does not find among the repair's touched names.
A fresh sweep of the codebase for unrelated defects, which the sealed-review limits already exclude.

evidence: Delivered sentences cover the repair case on both sides with no new-finding language; existing fix-verification limits in roles/reviewer.md and operations/review.md untouched; reader C answer in worker evidence/reader-grades.md

statement: A Worker applies the same focused-test search to a repair's own touched names, and in fix-verification an unrun matching test keeps the repaired finding open without becoming a new finding.
